name: Pediatrics Internship Program at Stanford (PIPS)
what_you_do: You do a seven-week summer internship in pediatrics at Stanford, about 30 hours a week. It is for students from nearby counties.
who_can_apply: Rising juniors and seniors, 16 or older, unweighted GPA of 3.0 or higher, living in and attending high school in San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Marin, Alameda, Contra Costa or Santa Cruz County. You must live with a family member or legal guardian; housing and transportation are not provided.
pay_detail: No fee. $3,000 stipend for students who show financial need.
duration: 7 weeks, 30 hours a week (2027: June 7 to July 23)
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 7, 2027. No closing date is posted. The 2026 deadline was Feb 23, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply online when applications open on Jan 7, 2027. Join the mailing list on the PIPS page to get a notice.
notes: About 35 to 40 students are admitted. The page says in person, with some remote work possible. You need a computer and internet. Grades from Fall 2026 count toward the GPA.
